correctness.rationale: For every prime p, index j>=1, modulus m>=1, free integral module A=Z[X]/Phi_{p^j}(X) is rank p^r over B=Z[Y]/Phi_{p^{j-r}}(Y), Y=X^{p^r}, for 0<=r<j. Multiplication by Y-1 has cokernel B/(Y-1)=Z/p and is nonsingular over Q; hence SNF(C^{p^r}-I) has exactly p^r diagonal p entries, all remaining entries 1. Modulo m fixed points are gcd(p,m)^{p^r}; C^{p^j}=I and Mobius/telescoping gives all cycle counts. This handles p=2,j=1,m=1. Reconstructed exact small cycle decompositions with disjoint cycles, e.g. (p,j,m)=(3,1,6): three fixed points and eleven 3-cycles, (2,2,4): two fixed, one 2-cycle and three 4-cycles. Finite replay is corroboration; universal assertion follows from the integral-module/SNF proof.
